newsitem.title: USA: Ohio air quality panel approves $46.5 mln of bonds.
newsitem.headline: Ohio air quality panel approves $46.5 mln of bonds.

text.p: The Ohio Air Quality Development Authority approved $46.5 million of tax-exempt revenue bonds in two issues Tuesday, executive director Mark Shanahan said.
The authority approved issuing $45 million of Solid Waste Project Revenue Bonds for a new U.S. Gypsum Co plant in Gypsum, Ohio, Shanahan said.
U.S. Gypsum, a subsidiary of USG Corp, anticipates that the negotiated deal will close in mid-September, Shanahan said.
Citicorp and First Commerce Capital of Montgomery, Ala., will serve as underwriters with Chapman & Cutler designated bond counsel, Shanahan said.
The authority also approved up to $1.5 million of bonds for heating and ventilation upgrades at the Department of Youth Services Cuyahoga Hills Boys School facility, Shanahan said.
Rieck Mechanical has a performance-based contract to perform the work and the negotiated deal is expected to close in about three weeks, Shanahan said.
Rieck has narrowed its list of potential underwriters and no outside bond counsel will be selected, Shanahan said.
